Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Shattering the Gates will only work if you're playing Enkil Cog.

Play Shattering the Gates during predator's turn, during your turn, and during prey's turn. Hopefully, you'll manage to lockdown some of your prey's vampires for 1 turn, so that she can't burn the Gate.

lockdown options: Barrenness on the 6-7 caps. Pentex on the others. Mind Numb. Mind Rape. any blood attrioning cards (rushing / stealing blood allies, Society of Leopold, ..)

Blocking possibilties: Unleash Hell's Fury, Carlton. Auspex / Animalism (animalism is better, because of Sense the Savage Way) ; Fortitude / Thaumaturgy / Serpentis brings the untaps.

Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
>
> > Baaliprimogen wrote:
> > And everybody wants to remove it.
> >
> For having tried it a few times, this is a wrong assumption. Not everyone with want to burn the shatter the gates, or have the possibility to do it.
> That doesn't mean Unleash Hell's Fury nor Enkil Cog shouldn't be used, but it isn't necessary to build a wall deck to use it.
>
I haven't done much with it, but I think people who just read the card don't realize how hard it is to burn the cards. I knew I could pull it off when my predator didn't try to get the Edge on the key turn.

Anyway, I see two paths for making it work. First is to defend the cards so that you actually give shattered counters out. The problem I see with this is that it's only likely to help your prey since you aren't putting as much pressure on as other decks. In theory, if you survive long enough, everyone else explodes. I'm not that confident on the surviving long enough plan. The second path is to put a lot of pool pressure on one's prey so that people fall in order. While this isn't likely to ensure that people get shattered, it has the advantage that you don't need to shatter them to win. In truth, my Shatter the Gates efforts have been to play the card as a distraction from doing better things.

Traveller Card Game

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
I use Nergal in my version. Eluding the Arms of Morpheus -> Diabolic Lure -> Mental Maze to block people and remain untapped (and discourage them from taking actions against me that they don't have to). Diabolic Lure at aus is bleed reduction, which is also handy, and I have twice ousted a prey by blocking a pool-gaining action and then playing Diabolic Lure, which I thought was hilarious.

People do have an unreasonable amount of hate for Shatter the Gate though, and sometimes try to burn it whether it's to their advantage or not.

The fact that Nergal with Enkil Cog can bleed for four with no cards and do it again in your preys turn is a good backup plan. I have won games where I failed to Shatter (and lost games after successfully shattering gates, but we don't talk about them).

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body: I do not see how none of these designs bother with House Of Sorrow. It can be used to help find the gates, or get rid of extras, when combined with Dreams (especially to put the last 2 counters on it) as well as other fun, and sometimes lungey, effects. But, most importantly, it can be used to untap the Enkil Cog after putting the first Shatter out on your grandpredators turn so that you can finish on your turn and, you know, hit your prey first.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
Shatter the Gates is like Smiling Jack. everybody would LIKE to remove it, but sometimes they're just too busy getting their game set up. or they'd really like to lunge this turn and maybe get a VP. they'll get around to dealing with it next turn, promise!

shattering fast is nice (since you have Infernal costs to pay and all) but sometimes you can get away with doing it at a slower pace.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Wand wrote:
> oh I didn't know because the card doesn't say that directly. So the card is just like spell of life?
>
No, multiple baali can play one shatter the gate each, unlike Spell of life. It's not overly useful, but you can do it.

A vampire can't play two time the same action card, or bleed two time, or do two political actions.

The only way to do a speed shatter is abusing Enkil Cog (or similar cards). You play one on your turn, untap, play another one during your prey turn, untap, untap the Enkil via House of sorrow or something, and play the third one. Good luck.
